variables.name: Refractive index
variables.description: Ratio of the speed of light in vacuum to its speed in the medium

variables.name: Refractive index of medium a
variables.description: Index of the first medium (light comes from here)

variables.name: Refractive index of medium b
variables.description: Index of the second medium

variables.name: Refractive index 1 (core)
variables.description: Index of the first medium or fibre core

variables.name: Refractive index 2 (cladding)
variables.description: Index of the second medium or fibre cladding

variables.name: Refractive index of the film
variables.description: Index of the thin film or the medium between lens and plate

variables.name: Numerical aperture
variables.description: Light-gathering ability of an optical fibre

variables.name: Speed of light in vacuum
variables.description: About 3×10⁸ m/s

variables.name: Phase velocity
variables.description: Speed of the wave in the medium

variables.name: Frequency / focal length
variables.description: Wave oscillations per second (for mirror formulas f is the focal length in m)

variables.name: Wavelength in the medium
variables.description: Distance between two successive crests

variables.name: Vacuum wavelength
variables.description: Wavelength before the wave enters a medium

variables.name: Vacuum permittivity
variables.description: Electric constant

variables.name: Vacuum permeability
variables.description: Magnetic constant

variables.name: Peak electric field
variables.description: Amplitude of the electric field

variables.name: Peak magnetic field
variables.description: Amplitude of the magnetic field

variables.name: Electric field
variables.description: Instantaneous electric field

variables.name: Magnetic field
variables.description: Instantaneous magnetic field

variables.name: Poynting vector magnitude
variables.description: Power per unit area carried by the wave

variables.name: Intensity
variables.description: Power per unit area

variables.name: Initial / maximum intensity
variables.description: Intensity before the element or at the central maximum

variables.name: Intensity after first polarizer
variables.description: Intensity of light after passing the first polarizer

variables.name: Maximum intensity
variables.description: Intensity transmitted when the axes are aligned

variables.name: Angle in medium a
variables.description: Angle of incidence measured from the normal

variables.name: Angle in medium b
variables.description: Angle of refraction measured from the normal

variables.name: Brewster angle
variables.description: Angle at which reflected light is fully polarized

variables.name: Critical angle
variables.description: Smallest angle of incidence giving total internal reflection

variables.name: Angle
variables.description: Angle from the central axis to the point on the screen

variables.name: Angle of incidence at first face
variables.description: Angle at the first prism face

variables.name: Angle at second face
variables.description: Angle at the second prism face

variables.name: Prism apex angle
variables.description: Angle between the two refracting faces

variables.name: Deviation angle
variables.description: Angle between incoming and outgoing ray

variables.name: Minimum deviation
variables.description: Smallest deviation produced by the prism

variables.name: Angular dispersion
variables.description: Difference in deviation between violet and red

variables.name: Deviation of violet light
variables.description: Deviation angle for violet

variables.name: Deviation of red light
variables.description: Deviation angle for red

variables.name: Phase difference
variables.description: Phase difference between the two waves (degrees in Malus' law: polarizer angle)

variables.name: Single-slit phase
variables.description: Phase parameter of single-slit diffraction

variables.name: Radius / screen distance
variables.description: Radius of curvature, or distance from slits to screen

variables.name: Radius of first surface
variables.description: Radius of curvature of the first lens surface

variables.name: Radius of second surface
variables.description: Radius of curvature of the second lens surface

variables.name: Object distance
variables.description: Distance from object to mirror or lens

variables.name: Image distance
variables.description: Distance from image to mirror or lens

variables.name: Order / magnification
variables.description: Fringe or maximum order (integer); for mirrors, magnification

variables.name: Optical power
variables.description: Power in dioptres (1/m)

variables.name: Path difference
variables.description: Difference in path length between the two rays

variables.name: Slit or grating separation
variables.description: Distance between adjacent slits

variables.name: Position of fringe m
variables.description: Distance of the m-th bright fringe from the centre

variables.name: Fringe spacing
variables.description: Distance between adjacent bright fringes

variables.name: Thickness
variables.description: Thickness of the thin film

variables.name: Radius of m-th ring
variables.description: Radius of the m-th Newton ring

variables.name: Mirror displacement
variables.description: Distance the Michelson mirror moves

variables.name: Slit width
variables.description: Width of the single slit

variables.name: Width of central maximum
variables.description: Full width of the central bright band

variables.name: Lines per metre
variables.description: Number of grating lines per metre
